items.headline: Real Madrid Becomes First Sports Club to Cross €1.2 Billion in Annual Revenue
items.summary: On July 28, 2026, Real Madrid approved its official financial results for the 2025–2026 season, reporting a record-breaking €1.221 billion in operating revenue [1.3.2]. This milestone makes the Spanish football club the first sports organization in history to surpass €1.2 billion in annual revenue, driven by expanded stadium operations and commercial growth.
